references.text: Describes the plains of Moab as the place where Moses spoke to the Israelites, the same geographical area mentioned in Joshua 13:32
Mentions the plains of Moab by the Jordan, near Jericho, as the site of the census under Moses
Refers to the plains of Moab by the Jordan, near Jericho, the same location where Moses distributed the inheritance
Describes the Israelites' camp in the plains of Moab by the Jordan, opposite Jericho, where Moses received instructions about the division of the land
The plains of Moab by the Jordan, near Jericho, are mentioned as the place where the Lord spoke to Moses about the Levitical cities
Concludes Numbers with a reference to the commands given in the plains of Moab by the Jordan, near Jericho
Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, the same area where he had distributed the inheritance east of the Jordan
Describes how the Israelites received their inheritance in the land of Canaan, in contrast to the inheritance Moses gave east of the Jordan
